test_aligner: test the AlignmentExtractor class to extract speech alignment durations from audio and reference text
create_AlignmentExtractor: create an AlignmentExtractor instance with aligner name, unit extractor, output layer, and kmeans model URI
run_extract_alignment: run extract_alignment on an AlignmentExtractor to get alignment durations from mono audio waveform and reference text
test_extract_alignment_fp16: test extract_alignment with fp16 dtype and verify alignment durations match reference fp16 durations tensor
test_extract_alignment_fp32: test extract_alignment with fp32 dtype and verify alignment durations match reference fp32 durations tensor
